intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Franklin for 2026, and here is what he found: 10 family events, 8 of them free. The magic runs from November 20 (FrankTown Festival of Lights) through December 31 (FrankTown Festival of Lights), with the Christmas Tree Lighting on the Square (December 4), the Franklin Christmas Parade (December 5) and Dickens of a Christmas (December 12 and 13) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Franklin

  • 10 Christmas events for kids in Franklin
  • 8 free events, including the Christmas Tree Lighting on the Square, the Franklin Christmas Parade and Dickens of a Christmas
  • Meet Santa: the Visit with Santa at the library, GingerSnapped photos with Santa and free photos with Santa at FrankTown Festival of Lights
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Tree Lighting on the Square (December 4), the Franklin Christmas Parade (December 5) and the Leiper's Fork Christmas Parade (December 12)
  • Lights: FrankTown Festival of Lights, a drive-through show with Walking Wednesdays
  • Season: November 20, 2026 to December 31, 2026

Planning a bigger day out? Franklin families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Nashville, which covers Gaylord Opryland's ICE featuring Home Alone, Holiday LIGHTS at Cheekwood, Glow Wild at Nashville Zoo and the Santa Express train.
